def test_SequentialGUIDerator___next____basic():
    # Create an instance; assume constructor sets pid to current os.getpid()
    guid = SequentialGUIDerator()
    # Verify initial pid matches the current process
    assert guid.pid == os.getpid()

    # First invocation: pid matches, so reseed() is NOT called
    first_val = guid.__next__()
    assert isinstance(first_val, str)
    # The result is a hexadecimal string (lowercase) due to '%x' formatting
    assert all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in first_val)

    # Change pid to a different value to trigger the reseed path
    guid.pid = os.getpid() + 1

    # Second invocation: pid differs, so reseed() IS called
    second_val = guid.__next__()
    assert isinstance(second_val, str)
    assert all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in second_val)

def test_redundant__cover_str_key():
    """Use a string attribute name as the key."""
    class Item:
        def __init__(self, name, value):
            self.name = name
            self.value = value

        def __repr__(self):
            return f"Item({self.name!r}, {self.value!r})"

    a1 = Item("a", 1)
    b1 = Item("b", 2)
    a2 = Item("a", 3)
    c1 = Item("c", 4)
    b2 = Item("b", 5)

    src = [a1, b1, a2, c1, b2]

    # groups=False: second occurrence of each duplicate name
    result = redundant(src, key="name")
    assert result == [a2, b2]  # objects are returned unchanged

    # groups=True: groups of objects sharing the same name
    groups = redundant(src, key="name", groups=True)
    assert groups == [[a1, a2], [b1, b2]]

def test_GUIDerator_reseed__basic(monkeypatch):
    # Prepare deterministic external values
    fake_pid = 12345
    fake_hostname = "testhost"
    fake_time = 1609459200.0  # 2021-01-01 00:00:00 UTC
    fake_urandom_bytes = b"\x01\x02\x03\x04\x05\x06"  # hex -> 010203040506

    # Monkey‑patch the external calls used by reseed
    monkeypatch.setattr("os.getpid", lambda: fake_pid)

def test_remap__enter_skips_traversal():
    data = {"list": [{"x": 1}, {"x": 2}], "val": 3}
    def my_enter(path, key, value):
        # Skip traversal of any list, keeping it as‑is
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return (value, False)
        return default_enter(path, key, value)
    def visit(path, key, value):
        if isinstance(value, int):
            return (key, value * 10)
        return (key, value)
    result = remap(data, visit=visit, enter=my_enter)
    # top‑level int transformed, inner dicts untouched because list was not traversed
    assert result == {"list": [{"x": 1}, {"x": 2}], "val": 30}
    # the list object itself should be the same (no copy)
    assert result["list"] is data["list"]
